# Ashutosh Singh — Staff Backend & Platform Engineer

> Staff-level backend and platform engineer with 13+ years of experience in Python, TypeScript, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, GCP, AWS, observability, and production reliability.

## About

Ashutosh Singh is a staff backend and platform engineer based in Pune, India. He builds production backend systems, cloud platforms, developer tooling, and AI-powered products. His recent work includes leading the CTP platform migration at Turing across GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes, Keycloak, Workload Identity Federation, GitHub Actions, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Redis, Secret Manager, Firebase, Discovery Engine, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Trace.

He is also the founder of Rigour Labs and creator of Rigour and Rigovo.

## Backend Staff Engineer Profile

Relevant backend strengths:

- Python backend services and FastAPI.
- TypeScript backend services with Node.js and Fastify.
- REST API design, service boundaries, and multi-tenant systems.
- PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL, Redis, Prisma, Firestore, and Supabase.
- Pub/Sub, event-driven architecture, idempotent consumers, task queues, DLQs, and event drainer patterns.
- Kubernetes, GKE, Terraform, Workload Identity Federation, Secret Manager, and GitHub Actions.
- Keycloak, OIDC, identity migration, SSO, IAM, and least-privilege access.
- Production debugging, structured logging, correlation IDs, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, SRE dashboards, and runbooks.
- Working familiarity with Go for backend systems.

## Turing CTP Platform

CTP is a task-operations platform connecting AGI-OS, Prism, identity, trainer workflows, task queues, media, QC, and canvas experiences.

Ashutosh led the modernization and migration across dev, preprod, and prod GCP projects:

- Designed Terraform-managed GCP foundation with isolated state buckets and mandatory team/cost labels.
- Built Workload Identity Federation for infra, CTP, identity, AGI-OS, Prism, and canvas repositories.
- Provisioned and managed GKE, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Secret Manager containers, Firebase, Discovery Engine, IAM, and monitoring.
- Migrated Keycloak identity to new endpoints with CTP-owned realm automation for Google broker, OIDC clients, roles, scopes, and admin bridge client.
- Built branch-based deployment and validation flow to avoid downtime during migration.
- Created Google Cloud Monitoring dashboards for p95 latency, RPS, 5xx, workloads, DLQs, event drainer, media/admin/annotator services, task usage, Prism QC, and AGI-OS integrations.
- Hardened task-queue lifecycle so seeded tasks are available for claim, claimed tasks track ownership, and submitted tasks enter QC cleanly.

## Products Built

### Rigour — Open-Source Quality Gates for AI-Generated Code

- Website: https://rigour.run
- Documentation: https://docs.rigour.run
- GitHub: https://github.com/rigour-labs/rigour
- NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rigour-labs/cli
- License: MIT

Rigour is a local-first, deterministic quality gate system that sits between AI coding agents and the codebase. It prevents AI agents from shipping TODO comments, God files, complexity violations, and security vulnerabilities.

Key capabilities:

- 19 quality gates.
- AST-based complexity analysis with web-tree-sitter.
- Security vulnerability detection.
- Fix Packet v2 schema for agent self-healing.
- MCP server integration for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, and VS Code.
- Multi-agent governance with scope isolation and conflict detection.
- TypeScript, JavaScript, and Python support.
- 44 semantic releases on NPM.

### Rigovo — AI-Powered Technical Hiring Platform

- Website: https://rigovo.com
- Product: https://rigovo.com/product

Rigovo deploys Maya, an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts 20-45 minute adaptive technical interviews via voice.

Key capabilities:

- 15-signal real-time verification engine.
- AI Collaboration Depth measurement.
- Evidence reports with skill-by-skill scoring.
- Stripe billing, WorkOS SSO, GDPR/CCPA data pipelines.
- 82 beta interviews processed, generating 6,824 signal events.
